scoring_justification: Headline transmittance and FWHM come from a full FEM simulation that the verifier cannot rerun; comparing reported values against paper-derived thresholds is the feasible scoring method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for transmittance and FWHM to meet the reproduction target
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports total transmissivity 72% and FWHM 0.8 µm; reproduction target set at ≥70% transmittance and ≤0.85 µm FWHM, absorbing small toolchain variations.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's own figures (Section 4, Abstract) with slack to accept a valid independent reproduction. The reference oracle writes the paper's exact numbers (0.72, 0.8).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traceable to the paper's abstract and Section 4; not invented.

outputs.description: Total transmissivity and full-width half-maximum at the focal plane of the designed grating focusing lens, obtained from full-device electromagnetic simulation.

output_contract.notes: The hidden scoring checks that transmittance >= hidden threshold and FWHM <= hidden threshold. Both conditions must be met for full credit.

steps.description: Ensure transmittance >= 0.70 and FWHM <= 0.85 µm with monotonic partial credit
